title: Foreknowledge: The Lurker's Lunge
body: You have seen this subway before. The lurker feints left, then lunges low from the right. Anyone warned in time can turn its strike aside.

title: Observation: Lurker Behavior
body: The platform lurker grows bolder against isolated prey and hesitates before groups that hold formation.

title: Foreknowledge: The Divided Plaza
body: At the station plaza the group will split over which exit to take. The quieter exit hides a trap; the louder one hides witnesses.

title: Fragment: The Eastern Route Is Dangerous
body: Something nests in the dark past the second pillar on the eastern route. You would not walk it alone.

title: Fragment: Something Valuable Hides East
body: Old-world supplies sit behind a shuttered kiosk on the eastern route — if anyone dares reach them.

title: Dokja's Whisper: On the Broker
body: Dokja went still when you named your sponsor. 'That constellation... it collects debts, not incarnations. Read every clause twice.'

title: Dokja Is Watching You
body: Kim Dokja has noticed your battle personally. Whatever you just did, it was not in the story he remembers.

title: Discovered: Iron Gate wants the eastern route
body: The Iron Gate wants the eastern route held at any cost — something it values moves through the dark there.

title: Discovered: The Warden's vigil list
body: The Silent Warden keeps a private list of incarnations under its protection. Names on it are never abandoned.

title: Discovered: Debts owed in the plaza
body: The Ledger claims every incarnation saved in the plaza owes it a favor — and it always collects.

title: Discovered: The Broker's ledger of names
body: The Whispering Broker records true allegiances. A name written there can be traded like coin.

title: Echo Across the Stream
body: Something impossible happened on another server, and the whole Star Stream heard it. You carry the echo.
